## What to look at when reviewing

<!-- Point at the parts that carry risk or that a reader would otherwise skim past:
     a security property, a constraint the schema now enforces, a trade-off taken. -->

## Not covered

<!-- What was deliberately left out, and where it is tracked. "Nothing" is a valid
     answer; silence is not. -->

---

- [ ] A decision that was not obvious is recorded in an ADR
- [ ] `docs/ROADMAP.md` reflects what is now done, and open questions are in the table
- [ ] New behaviour has a test, and a fixed bug has a test that would have caught it
- [ ] Anything asserted about a library or the database was verified, or is marked as
      unverified so CI decides
